simple.summary: גִּתַּיִם (Gittayim) means Gittajim , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 2Sam 4 3.

definitions.full: H1664. Gittayim גִּתַּיִם proper name, of a location גִּתִּית adjective see below יגן . p. 387 f גִּתָּ֑יִם proper name, of a location in Judah ; — ׳ג Neh 11:33 ; גִּתָּ֑יְמָה 2Sam 4:3 ; site unknown.
